description:
Get Tripadvisor Reviews

Fetches reviews of one Tripadvisor place by its numeric place ID (the `placeId` returned by the Tripadvisor Search API, or the number after `-d` in a Tripadvisor URL), up to 20 per request with offset pagination. Filter by star rating (`rating[]`), month of the visit (`month[]`), type of visit (`typeOfVisit[]`: business, couples, family, friends, solo) and review language (`language`); sort by most recent or most detailed. A language filter also returns reviews machine-translated into that language: each review reports its `language` and `originalLanguage`. Returns `searchInformation.totalReviews` for the filters, `pagination` with the next offset and a `hasdataLink` to the next page (absent on the last page), and per review the title, text, rating, sub-ratings, link, date, trip date and type, tips, photos, helpful votes, the author (username, display name, profile link, avatar, contribution count, hometown) and the owner response. Use it for sentiment analysis, competitor and reputation monitoring, or hospitality datasets.

domain.description: Tripadvisor domain to use. The domain sets the language of the results. Default is `www.tripadvisor.com`.

language.description: Review language code, e.g. `en` or `fr`. Includes reviews machine-translated into it; compare `language` and `originalLanguage` on each review. All languages when omitted.

month__.description: Only reviews of visits in these months (1 = January). Multiple values are combined with OR.

offset.description: Number of reviews to skip. Use `pagination.nextOffset` from the previous response, or call `pagination.hasdataLink`, which repeats every filter with the next offset.

placeId.description: Tripadvisor place ID, as returned by the Tripadvisor Search API.

rating__.description: Only reviews with these ratings. Multiple values are combined with OR.

typeOfVisit__.description: Only reviews of these trip types. Multiple values are combined with OR.
